mission.title: Cut Both Ways
mission.description: Answer Halborn's latest disruptions, and contain his override programs when he turns on the Cypherites.

npc.say: Next time I see Veil's ship, she'll get a shiny new missile cluster to play with...
Fortunatamente, a separate target for his anger over this incident has already been arranged.

Huh! Maybe they had a deal with Veil--ever think about that? Maybe that's why you're here right now.
Anyway, you better just follow your orders. It's what you're good at.

phase.briefing:
Halborn, following the Cypherites toward what they told him was Carlyne's ship, encountered a large fleet of Zion and EPN hovercraft attempting to conduct a transfer of Zion's ex-commander, Jason Lock, to New Zion.
While the outcome of this battle is still unclear, what is clear is that Halborn did not locate Carlyne's ship. Since that time, he has created several disruptions within the simulation, of the type he has used in the past as means to attract our attention. You will investigate, and find out what he wants.

enter.say:
Halborn sure likes to do things the hard way... I suppose he thinks throwing a tantrum helps get his message across.
I sure as hell want to know more about that hovercraft encounter. With all those Cyphs there, it must've turned into a battle. Hm... Maybe we can check with one of the liaison officers later for an update.
Okay, override codes galore in there. Might be time to do a little hand-holding.

talk.say:
Your Cypherite pals almost got me killed! I don't think they knew squat about Carlyne's location.
Get me the suits. We need to talk.

done.say: Gah, this guy is needy. All right, all right, I'm dialing up Mr. Gray...

phase.briefing: Dissemination of confidential information on an individual basis must be scrutinized carefully. You may speak to Agent Pace at the indicated location.

enter.say: Hey, that's weird... Pace is there, but I don't see an override signal on the screen. Halborn late to his own meeting?

talk.say:
Ciao, tesoro. Halborn won't be joining us. We have already told him that we cannot answer his question about the location of Carlyne's vessel, so it seemed...pointless to try to respond to the same question again, especially now that he is particularly upset.
What we told him was the truth, as he knows. He has reaped the rewards of the established order, but he has no respect for it. He is a very dangerous man, {player}.

done.say: But...won't this just tick him off even more?

near.say: I still don't see any sign of Halborn anywhere nearby. Someone give him the wrong address?

phase.briefing: An outbreak of override programs has been detected at what we believe to have been a Cypherite installation. We would like this investigated.

enter.say: I've got override signals in there, all right--some redpills, too.

talk.say:
Halborn's been tearing right through us! He chased off some of the others, but we were trapped in here by his programs.
You'd better give us a hand; I bet this is all because Veil agreed to show him around when you guys didn't want to handle it yourselves.

done.say: You are permitted to assist the Cypherites in this case, operative. You are still not to engage Halborn himself under any circumstances.

near.say: There are the redpills I was picking up.

phase.briefing: His programs should be contained, if possible.

enter.say: Override signals lighting up my screen... He's really going to town on the Cypherites.

done.say: I think that's all of them, except for Halborn. Uh... Do we really want to see what he's up to?

talk.say: Yeah?! Come on. You people made a big mistake when you tried putting one over on me. You're not going to be able to cover this up!

done.say: Paranoid people are so fun to tease.
It's all just a damn conspiracy... You're being manipulated by someone who knows the program exists--knows exactly what it is. You idiots!

mission.finish:
This outlet seems to have cooled his temper, at least at present. Unfortunately, the necessity of indulging some of his previous requests has made him ever more difficult to deal with; like a spoiled child, he angers all the more rapidly when his slightest demand is not met. But the rules and regulations that he has relied upon do not exist solely for his own benefit.
That will be all for now, {player}.
